skills.name: remotion-video
skills.title_zh: 用 React 代码做视频
skills.tagline_zh: 改一句话就要重剪一遍视频，谁受得了？把视频写成 React 组件后，改一行参数整片重渲染，动画、字幕、音乐可视化全都能版本控制。
skills.tagline_en: Programmatic video with Remotion — content defined as React components, covering animation, subtitles and music visualization; change a param, re-render the whole film.
skills.desc_en: 使用 Remotion 框架以编程方式创建视频。Remotion 让你用 React 组件定义视频内容，支持动画、字幕、音乐可视化等。 触发词： - "用代码做视频"、"编程视频"、"React 视频" - "Remotion"、"remotion" - "/remotion-video" 适用场景： - 程序化视频：(1) 批量生成 (2) 数据驱动（如年度总结）(3) 音乐可视化 (4) 自动字幕 - 教程讲解视频：(5) 技术概念可视化（如 CNN、算法）(6) 分层递进讲解 (7) AI 配音教程 - 3D 视频：(8) 产品展示/模型动画 (9) 卡通角色讲解 (10) 3D 数据可视化 (11) Logo 动画
skills.why_zh: 视频变成可版本控制的代码，是「AI 做视频」里最扎实的一路；和店里的 HyperFrames 同哲学，一个 React 一个 HTML。
skills.why_en: Video as version-controlled code — the most solid school of AI video, sharing a philosophy with our HyperFrames pick: one in React, one in HTML.

skills.name: ian-xiaohei-illustrations
skills.title_zh: 给中文文章画手绘感解释图
skills.tagline_zh: 写完文章配图最头疼：截图太丑、AI 插画太飘。它专画流程、结构、隐喻——16:9 白底手绘，少量红橙蓝批注，一篇文章配下来像一个人画的。
skills.tagline_en: Ian-style illustrations for Chinese article bodies — 16:9 hand-drawn on white with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, built for processes, structures, metaphors and arguments.
skills.desc_en: 生成 Ian 风格的中文正文配图。用于用户要求为中文文章、帖子、博客、Notion 文档、工作流文档、方法论、流程、结构、状态、隐喻或观点生成“怪诞”“小黑”“手绘”“正文配图”“文章插图”“配图建议”“shot list”“去标题/改图”等任务；默认使用小黑 IP、纯白手绘、少量红橙蓝批注、简洁清爽但天马行空的视觉风格。
skills.why_zh: 9462 星的中文爆款，也是「单一明确风格」的典范：不给你一堆选项，一种腔调做到底，所以全篇视觉统一。
skills.why_en: A 9.5k-star Chinese hit and a model of single-style discipline — one voice all the way through, so every figure in an article looks like one hand drew it.

skills.name: codex-ppt
skills.title_zh: 把文章变成视觉统一的图片式 PPT
skills.tagline_zh: 讲稿有了、排版要命。它逐页出图，整套风格一以贯之——适合那种「好看比可编辑更要紧」的场合，比如路演和分享会。
skills.tagline_en: Turns articles, reports or outlines into visually unified image-based decks — page-by-page generation with GPT-Image-2 holding one consistent style throughout.
skills.desc_en: Generate visually unified image-based PPT/PPTX decks from articles, reports, papers, notes, or outlines.
skills.why_zh: 4865 星。分工清楚：不追求可编辑，追求每页都好看且像同一套，视觉一致性是它的卖点。
skills.why_en: 4.9k stars, with a clear lane: not editability but every page looking good and belonging to the same set. Visual consistency is the pitch.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 把一个模糊主题做成深度调研报告
skills.tagline_zh: 想调研一个话题，AI 却给你一篇维基摘要？这套八步法逼它先拆问题再找料，产出的是能拿去做决策的报告，不是概述。
skills.tagline_en: Wang Shuyi's eight-step research methodology — turns a vague topic into a high-quality research report; "research this for me" triggers it.
skills.desc_en: 深度调研方法论（8步法）：将模糊主题转化为高质量调研报告。 触发词：/deep-research、深度调研、帮我调研、调研一下、对比分析 注意：如果用户需要的是可视化图谱而非报告，请使用 research-to-diagram skill。
skills.why_zh: 作者高校教师出身、常年教研究方法，这八步是真在带学生做研究时用的那套，不是拍脑袋编的流程。
skills.why_en: By a university teacher who has taught research method for years — these eight steps come from actually supervising research, not from a whiteboard.

skills.name: research-to-diagram
skills.title_zh: 调研完自动画成知识关系图 PDF
skills.tagline_zh: 研究做完还得画图讲给别人听——这步最烦。给它一个主题，它联网调研、整理、直接输出专业关系图谱 PDF，一步到位。
skills.tagline_en: Give it a topic: it researches online, organizes the findings, and outputs a professional knowledge-relationship diagram as PDF, end to end.
skills.desc_en: 深度调研主题并自动生成知识关系图谱PDF。接收研究主题后自动进行网络调研、信息收集、知识整理，最终生成专业的可视化关系图谱。适用于"研究...并做图"、"深度分析...并可视化"、"生成知识图谱"等场景。
skills.why_zh: 「调研完还得画图」是研究者的隐性负担，它把两步接成一步，产物是能放进正式文档的 PDF。
skills.why_en: Researchers quietly carry the burden of diagramming after research; this fuses both steps and ships a PDF you can put in a real document.

skills.name: zettel-builder
skills.title_zh: 把零散笔记养成会提醒你写文的卡片库
skills.tagline_zh: 笔记越存越多，却从没变成一篇文章。它把笔记消化成原子卡、按你的话重述、自动连线，还定期告诉你：这几张已经攒够写一篇了。
skills.tagline_en: A bottom-up Zettelkasten that digests notes, published pieces and saved material into atomic cards — restated in your own terms, auto-linked, with periodic checks for clusters ripe enough to become an article.
skills.desc_en: 自底向上生长的 Zettelkasten 卡片笔记系统。从笔记/已发表文章/收藏素材持续消化为原子卡, 用户价值观重述,自动链接,周期性巡检文章就绪簇,缺口处可调 deep-research 补卡。 与"自顶向下选题"或"长文写作 Skill"不重叠:那些是"等到要写时再生产",本 skill 是"素材进来就长卡"。 触发词: - "/zettel"、"/zettel-builder" - "卡片笔记"、"zettelkasten"、"原子卡"、"二级大脑" - "巡检卡片"、"长出来一篇"、"卡片就绪了吗" - "把这段切卡"、"做成卡片" 四种模式(由用户调用语义路由): - ingest:把指定素材(文本/路径/URL/本会话片段)切原子卡 → 价值观重述 → 候选链接 - scan:消化 _queue/ 里 mechanical scan 积累的 llm-wiki 新增素材 - i
skills.why_zh: 「巡检文章就绪簇」是灵魂：大多数笔记系统只管存，它管「什么时候该动笔」。
skills.why_en: Flagging article-ready clusters is the soul of it — most note systems only store; this one tells you when it's time to write.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 十分钟出一份带出处的深度调研
skills.tagline_zh: 要判断一个行业或标的，自己查三天还不确定？多个智能体分工去查、互相交叉验证，十分钟给你一份券商体例、条条有出处的报告。
skills.tagline_en: One command, ten minutes, one brokerage-grade deep research report — multi-agent collaboration with automatic verification and cross-checking, fully sourced.
skills.desc_en: Professional deep research report generation — multi-agent collaboration with parallel chapter writing, automatic latest-data targeting, multilingual output, and built-in quality checks.
skills.why_zh: 敢喊「券商级」就得扛住，它靠的是多智能体分工加交叉验证，而不是一次生成一篇长文糊弄。
skills.why_en: Claiming brokerage grade sets a bar, and it meets it with divided agent labor and cross-verification rather than one long confident essay.

skills.name: pixelpad
skills.title_zh: 在 24×24 画布上画原生像素图
skills.tagline_zh: 想要一张像素风头像或游戏精灵，AI 给的却是大图缩小后的糊边。它逐像素落调色板索引，边缘是硬的，还能导出一格格蹦出来的显影动画。
skills.tagline_en: Native 24x24 pixel art — every pixel is a palette index placed on purpose, not a downscaled render; exports transparent PNG plus a pixel-by-pixel reveal GIF.
skills.desc_en: Draw native 24x24 pixel art by placing palette indices per pixel (never downscaling a big image); exports transparent PNG plus a pixel-by-pixel reveal GIF.
skills.why_zh: 本店自制。质量不靠一次成型，靠「画→渲染→自己看一眼→改」的回环，两轮从一团色到能用；全本地跑，不调图像 API。器物比有机形体扎实。
skills.why_en: Made in-house. Quality comes not from one-shot generation but from teaching the agent to draw, render, actually look, and fix — usually two rounds from blob to usable sprite. Fully local.

skills.name: guizang-material-illustration
skills.title_zh: 生成有材质感的解释图和文章配图
skills.tagline_zh: 解释性配图最难两全：准确的往往丑，好看的往往说不清。歸藏这套专攻这一点——材质质感 + 文字标注，一眼看懂还挺好看。
skills.tagline_en: Generates Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory diagrams and chart beautification — the article visuals that are both instantly legible and good-looking.
skills.desc_en: Generate Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory visuals, material-styled chart illustrations, and data-first editorial images from articles, notes, product concepts, workplace reports, creator posts, tutorials, school materials, humanities topics, science explanations, screenshots, or chart data. Use when the user asks for 配图, 带字插图, 解释图, 图解插画, 概念拆解图, 图表美化, 数据图美化, 3D 图表, 汇报配图, 内容
skills.why_zh: 992 星的中文精品，作者是中文 AI 设计内容的头部创作者，审美有背书。
skills.why_en: A 989-star Chinese standout — explanatory visuals must be accurate and attractive at once, and this material style is the benchmark.

skills.name: gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-3
skills.title_zh: 把一句话变成极简杂志感海报
skills.tagline_zh: 想给文章配张有格调的图，AI 却总给你花里胡哨那种？它只做一件事：大留白、一处小拼贴、一个色彩重音，出的是编辑部的克制。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a sentence, an article, a mood or a photo and get a paper-textured minimal zine poster — vast negative space, one small collage anchor, experimental typography, a single clear color accent.
skills.desc_en: Generate or analyze poetic paper-texture minimal zine posters with large negative space, a small editorial collage or visual anchor, experimental typography, and one clear color accent. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, article, mood, object, photo, content brief, reference images, or an image folder and wants a final poster image, a production-ready image prompt, reusable style rules, or
skills.why_zh: 5691 星、236 fork。稀有在它卖「克制」——这是提示词最难稳定复现的高级感。带 evals 自测集，作者真在维护风格一致性。装 Codex 用，也可把内容直接贴给网页版模型。
skills.why_en: A 5.7k-star, 236-fork hit that sells restraint — vast negative space with one color accent is exactly the kind of taste prompts rarely reproduce reliably. Ships with an eval set and reference images, so the author is genuinely maintaining style consistency. Built for Codex.

skills.name: ai-short-drama
skills.title_zh: 从零做一集 AI 短剧
skills.tagline_zh: 短剧是眼下最猛的内容形态，但一个人搞不定编剧+分镜+成片。它把这条流水线拆成能一步步走完的活。
skills.tagline_en: From hit radar to episode hooks, it crafts your binge-worthy series bible—keeps characters consistent and writes.
skills.desc_en: 設計、編劇、製作與迭代爆款 AI 短劇／漫劇／仿真人直式連載。用於「AI短劇」「AI漫劇」「爽劇」「微短劇」「假廢物真強者」「扮豬吃虎」「重生」「轉生／穿越」「系統流」「隱藏大佬／隱藏身份」「逆襲／打臉／復仇」「真假千金」「末世」「修仙」「規則怪談」「ReelShort／DramaBox 風」「分集大綱」「每集鉤子」「季節拍」「短劇角色一致性」「把小說改短劇」「短劇為什麼不爆」「規劃一季／寫下一集」「從故事到AI成片」「一鍵做短劇」「100%自動化」「全部你來」等任務。負責題材雷達、概念綠燈、系列 Bible、爽點與揭露階梯、分集編劇、連載狀態、production pack、可續跑生成、成片 QA 與成效回填；實際媒體提示詞交給 ai-media-generator，完整剪輯交付可串接 video-autopilot 或相容執行器。
skills.why_zh: 体量不大但路子对，适合先试水短剧的人；要成体系的还得看更完整的方案。
skills.why_en: It closes the loop from writing to QA to feedback, auto-maintains character consistency, and can continue the whole season—not.

skills.name: 风格包
skills.title_zh: 从参考图提取可复用的视觉风格包
skills.tagline_zh: 看到一个喜欢的画面，想把那股味道复用到自己的东西上——但说不清它到底哪里对。它拆出 10 色标注色卡和风格参数，把感觉变成能交付的东西。
skills.tagline_en: Extracts reusable visual style DNA from reference images, film stills or video frames — always emitting a labeled ten-color palette plus a flat version, packaged as a style pack.
skills.desc_en: 从一组参考图、电影剧照、视频截图或用户给定文件夹中提取可复用的视觉风格 DNA，打包成中文风格包；提取模式强制为每个视觉分组同时生成统一 10 色标注色卡和完全无文字纯色色卡，并生成两套色卡总览与可复用色值 JSON。也可读取已有风格包的 design.md 和提示词模板，把剧本、脚本表格或创意需求拆成文生图提示词 + 视频提示词表格文档。触发词包括“风格包”“提取某电影风格包”“按这个风格包生成提示词”“读取这个文件夹的风格 DNA”“用风格包拆剧本”“生成色卡”“生成文生图和视频提示词表格”。核心原则：只参考视觉语法，绝对避免场景和元素雷同。
skills.why_zh: 强制输出带标注色卡和纯色版，这一步让「风格」从形容词变成可传递的资产。
skills.why_en: "I love this look, make my stuff feel like it" is a real recurring need; this converts a vibe into deliverable palettes and parameters.

skills.name: qiaomu-learning
skills.title_zh: 用一问一答逼你自己想明白
skills.tagline_zh: AI 直接给答案，学的时候最爽、也最没用。丢一份教材、截图或一道题给它，它一次只问一个问题，带你自己推出来。
skills.tagline_en: Turns textbooks, screenshots, PDFs, notes or a single problem into a question-by-question derivation — one question at a time, making you reason it out instead of handing over answers.
skills.desc_en: 用苏格拉底式逐问学习把教材、截图、PDF、笔记、题目或一个主题变成主动推导对话。Use when the learner明确要求“苏格拉底式学习”“逐问带我学”“一次只问一个问题”“先别告诉我答案”“边问边引导我推出来”、interactive quiz、active recall or question-led tutoring。宽泛主题默认先进入关键词定向：列出 12 个关键词及白话解释，推荐专家和专业书籍，并提供“扩展关键词”的入口，再让学习者选起点。正式学习中每个活跃回合只问一个简短、可回答的问题，并根据学习者上一步的推理调整难度；回答要接住学习者原话，像真人老师一样温和纠错，并在数学、物理、流程或图形内容中用累积黑板逐步画出推理。学习者说“太抽象”“不理解”“想象不出来”“枯燥”或要求图解，且当前台阶可视觉化时，必须立即切换为问题承载型图示并提供文字替代，空间、相对运动、流程和几
skills.why_zh: AI 毁掉学习的最快方式就是给答案；「一次只问一个」这条硬约束正是解药。乔木出品。
skills.why_en: The fastest way AI ruins learning is handing over answers; the one-question-at-a-time constraint is exactly the antidote.

skills.name: skills
skills.title_zh: 让 agent 自己开浏览器干活
skills.tagline_zh: 很多事没有 API 只有网页：查后台、填表单、抓数据。装上它，agent 能自己打开浏览器点点点，还能穿过反爬墙。
skills.tagline_en: AI stuck behind anti-bot walls? It hands off to humans, runs parallel sessions with isolated accounts—like a.
skills.desc_en: Browser automation CLI built for AI agents. Break through anti-bot walls, hand off to humans across platforms when stuck. Parallel multi-task execution, independent multi-session operation, isolated multi-account browsing.
skills.why_zh: 5334 星。它解决的是「agent 能想但手伸不出去」的根本限制，是能力型基建件。
skills.why_en: Unlike brute-force bypassers, it escalates to humans on blocks and isolates sessions—no cross-account leaks.

skills.name: unlazy
skills.title_zh: 逼 agent 干完重活别糊弄
skills.tagline_zh: 长任务做到一半开始偷懒、「差不多就这样吧」是通病。深度树把任务分层拆开，每层必须做完才准往上收。
skills.tagline_en: An anti-laziness discipline for substantial work — the Depth Tree method splits a task into layers, each of which must be finished before rolling up. No more "good enough, I guess".
skills.desc_en: Anti-laziness execution discipline for substantial tasks. Use when work keeps coming back half done, when an agent reports done before it is done, when output must be exhaustive rather than fast, on long autonomous runs that tend to stall at 80 percent, or on any invocation like /unlazy, "tree N", "gates", or "do not stop until it is done". v2 enforces completion through gate files and runnable ch
skills.why_zh: 把「分层且必须完成」变成硬纪律，比反复叮嘱它认真干有效得多。
skills.why_en: Agents start cutting corners mid-task; enforcing layered completion beats repeatedly telling them to try harder.

skills.name: moonlit-book-workflow
skills.title_zh: 给自家孩子做一本带家长配音的绘本
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子想听独属于他的故事。12 页英文绘本，固定水彩画风 + 角色设定图保证每页都是同一个小孩，再用你自己的声音朗读，出一个能直接发出去的文件。
skills.tagline_en: Makes a 12-page personalized English picture book for your kid — a fixed watercolor house style plus a per-book character sheet keeps the child looking like the same character across all pages, narrated in a parent's own cloned voice, shipped as one sendable HTML file.
skills.desc_en: Build or resume a reusable 12-page personalized English picture book in a fixed watercolor house style, with a per-book character sheet for illustration consistency and local authorized-adult voice cloning for narration.
skills.why_zh: 难点它都啃了：AI 插画最容易每页换个人，它用画风锚点+角色设定图锁死；声音只收成人授权音、监护人确认才继续，私密音频永不进成品。限 Apple Silicon + Codex，本地模型约 3.2G。
skills.why_en: It solves the hard parts: AI illustration usually drifts into a different-looking child each page, so it locks consistency with a style anchor plus a character sheet; voice cloning accepts only authorized adult recordings with guardian checkpoints, and private audio never ships in the output. Apple Silicon Mac + Codex only, ~3.2GB local model.

skills.name: fit-ride-studio
skills.title_zh: 读懂运动手表导出的轨迹数据
skills.tagline_zh: 手表导出一堆 FIT/KML 文件，多数人看不懂也懒得看。它把功率、心率、爬升、配速逐段拆开，还出可视化路书。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes cycling, running and hiking FIT/KML tracks — power, heart rate, elevation and pacing broken down segment by segment, with visual route reports.
skills.desc_en: Analyze one or more cycling, running, or hiking FIT/KML activity tracks, generate evidence-based single or aggregate reports, open the bundled local Ride Relief report page when the environment supports it, enrich results with user-confirmed public location context, and create shareable PNG or H.264 MP4 route stories on request. Use whenever a user wants to analyze, compare, visualize, or export .
skills.why_zh: 把一墙传感器读数翻译成「这趟骑得怎么样」，骑行跑步徒步都能用。
skills.why_en: Most people never decode their watch exports; this translates a wall of sensor data into "how was that ride, really".

skills.name: interactive-map-builder
skills.title_zh: 把地点数据变成可交互的网页地图
skills.tagline_zh: 做旅行攻略、门店分布、活动路线，最后总卡在「怎么做一张能点的地图」。给它数据，它出一个能直接发的交互地图。
skills.tagline_en: Turn Excel coords into a searchable, filterable map—single HTML file, paper-ready SVG/PDF, even non-coders can.

skills.name: superpowers-zh
skills.title_zh: 11 万星 superpowers 的完整中文版
skills.tagline_zh: 原版方法论很好但全英文，中文团队用起来隔一层。这版不只翻译，还补了中文 commit 规范、中文 review 话术、国内团队反模式。
skills.tagline_en: A full Chinese localization of the 116k-star superpowers, plus six China-originated skills — Chinese commit conventions, review phrasing and local team anti-patterns.
skills.desc_en: 🦸 AI 编程超能力 · 中文增强版 — superpowers（116k+ ⭐）完整汉化 + 6 个中国原创 skills，让 Claude Code / Copilot CLI / Hermes Agent / Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro / Gemini CLI 等 16 款 AI 编程工具真正会干活
skills.why_zh: 7716 星。补的是「本土协作场景」，这部分原版不会有。
skills.why_en: The original methodology is strong but English-only; this isn't just translation — it adds originals for how Chinese teams actually collaborate.

skills.name: antinet-four-color-cards
skills.title_zh: 把一份文档拆成四色行动卡
skills.tagline_zh: 读完一份合同或报告，记不住重点也不知道下一步做什么。它拆成蓝卡（事实）、绿卡（解释）、黄卡（风险）、红卡（行动）。
skills.tagline_en: Breaks a document into four colored cards — blue facts, green interpretation, yellow risks, red actions — so what to note, guard against and do is immediately clear.
skills.desc_en: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。
skills.why_zh: 颜色分层这个输出格式很聪明：把「读完了」变成「能行动」，看合同、报告、竞品资料尤其顺。
skills.why_en: The color-layered output is clever — it converts "I read it" into "I can act", especially for contracts, reports and competitor material.

skills.name: home-assistant-manager
skills.title_zh: 用对话管理智能家居的自动化配置
skills.tagline_zh: Home Assistant 的 YAML 改错一行，整屋自动化就哑掉。它带安全校验再部署，还能排查设备失联——终于不用手写配置了。
skills.tagline_en: Manage all of Home Assistant by conversation — safely edit automation YAML, deploy scripts and blueprints, debug offline devices. No more hand-written config.
skills.desc_en: Manage Home Assistant configuration safely and fast — edit and deploy YAML (automations, blueprints, scripts, scenes, templates, MQTT), validate with ha core check, deploy via git or rapid scp, reload-vs-restart correctly, verify changes from logs, traces and entity state, and build Lovelace dashboards. Use for any Home Assistant config, automation, template, or dashboard work over SSH/hass-cli/MC
skills.why_zh: 779 星。「校验后再部署」这个设计是敢让 AI 碰真设备的前提。
skills.why_en: HA's YAML is the smart-home hobbyist's shared pain — one wrong line silences the house; this validates before deploying, so letting AI touch real devices is safe.

skills.name: anti-autoresearch
skills.title_zh: 核查一篇论文是不是 AI 编的
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写的论文越来越多，数据对不上、引用编造、结论超出证据。它做实质性诚信取证，专查这类漏洞。
skills.tagline_en: Runs a substantive-integrity forensic sweep on a paper, aimed at AI-generated research — mismatched data, fabricated citations, conclusions outstripping evidence.
skills.desc_en: End-to-end substantive-integrity forensic sweep of a research paper (especially autoresearch / AI-Scientist-style output). Orchestrates the whole pipeline: ingest (arxiv-id | pdf | dir → working dir + pdftotext for L0) → /evidence-ledger (artifact manifest + observability level L0/L1/L2 + span-anchored claims.json) → fan out the integrity auditor skills (consistency, citation, baseline, experiment
skills.why_zh: 立意站在学术诚信这边，做法也具体——反向取证的工具比生成工具少得多。
skills.why_en: AI-written papers keep multiplying while integrity forensics stays rare; this stands on the right side and does it concretely.

skills.name: skills-janitor
skills.title_zh: 给你装的技能库做体检和减法
skills.tagline_zh: 装得越多上下文越挤，还不知道哪个在偷偷吃 token、哪个藏着提示注入。它左滑扔掉浪费的、扫风险、给诚实的 token 账单。
skills.tagline_en: A health check for your installed skills — swipe away context wasters, scan for prompt injection, get an honest token bill. It calls itself Tinder for skills.
skills.desc_en: Tinder for your Claude Code skills. Swipe away what wastes context, scan for prompt injection, get honest token costs. 6 commands, zero dependencies, Claude Code + Codex.
skills.why_zh: 这个生态罕见的「减法」工具：装得多不等于装得好，它同时管省上下文、防注入、看清成本。
skills.why_en: More installed isn't better: it handles context waste, injection risk and real cost at once — a rare subtractive tool in this ecosystem.

skills.name: diagram
skills.title_zh: 自动选对图表类型再画出来
skills.tagline_zh: 多数人卡在「该用泳道图还是时序图」，不是不会画。它先按需求选型，再从 29 种里出符合规范的 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Picks the right chart type for your need and renders it — 29 kinds including swimlanes, sequence, ER, Gantt, Kanban and Git graphs, straight to spec-compliant PNG.
skills.desc_en: 专业图表生成技能：根据需求自动选择合适的图表类型，生成符合设计规范的 PNG 图表。 覆盖 29 种图表：结构图（流程图、泳道图、时序图、架构图、状态图、ER图、类图、思维导图、甘特图、Kanban、Git Graph 等） 和统计图（柱状图、折线图、饼图、雷达图、热力图、散点图、桑基图、漏斗图、瀑布图、矩形树图、柱线混合图等）。 统一工具：HTML/SVG + 内联 JS 布局计算。ER/类图使用 ELKjs 布局引擎。 所有图表遵循统一的设计规范（配色/字体/组件/间距），风格现代简洁。 支持三种输出：PNG（默认）、HTML（富文档嵌入）、DSL（Mermaid 文本，嵌入 MD 文档）。 触发词：画图、画一个、生成图表、流程图、架构图、时序图、柱状图、对比图、关系图。 即使用户没有说"画图"，只要需求中涉及可视化展示（流程、架构、数据对比、关系），都应触发此技能。 被 deep-r
skills.why_zh: 先选型后出图这个顺序，比丢给你一堆模板实用得多。
skills.why_en: Most people stall on which chart, not how to draw it; choosing the type before rendering is more useful than handing over templates.

skills.name: tufte
skills.title_zh: 按塔夫特原则画极简数据图
skills.tagline_zh: 默认图表总是花里胡哨：网格、阴影、图例挤成一团。它砍掉一切多余装饰、拉高数据墨水比，出的图有种克制的高级感。
skills.tagline_en: Turns "make me a chart" into a Tufte-compliant one — max data-ink, zero junk, distilled from his three foundational books.
skills.desc_en: Apply Edward Tufte's principles to any data visualization, chart, dashboard, or infographic. Use when the user asks to produce, design, critique, or improve a chart, graph, dashboard, KPI tile, table-with-data, sparkline, small multiple, time series, distribution plot, choropleth, or any other visual that communicates quantitative or categorical information. Also triggers on words like "visualize"
skills.why_zh: 数据可视化的品味天花板就是塔夫特，它把「少即是多」变成可执行规则，而不是口号。
skills.why_en: Tufte is the ceiling of data-viz taste; this makes "less is more" executable — restrained, high-end charts instead of rainbow clutter.

skills.name: excalidraw-diagram
skills.title_zh: 生成手绘白板风格的示意图
skills.tagline_zh: 讲思路时精确框图显得冷，手绘草图更让人愿意看。它出真正的 Excalidraw 文件，画完你还能自己拖着改。
skills.tagline_en: Generates Excalidraw hand-drawn diagram JSON for workflows, architectures and concepts — that whiteboard-sketch warmth, still editable on import.
skills.desc_en: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files that make visual arguments. Use when the user wants to visualize workflows, architectures, or concepts.
skills.why_zh: 4463 星。产物是可编辑源文件而不是截图，这一点决定了它能进日常工作流而不只是配图。
skills.why_en: Hand-drawn beats rigid boxes for explaining ideas warmly; real Excalidraw files you keep editing after.

skills.name: obsidian-cli
skills.title_zh: 用命令行让 agent 读写你的 Obsidian 库
skills.tagline_zh: 笔记都在 Obsidian 里，AI 却看不见。装上它 agent 能直接读写笔记、搜索、改属性和任务——作者就是 Obsidian 的 CEO。
skills.tagline_en: Drive your Obsidian vault from the CLI — read, create, search notes and manage tasks and properties. Built by kepano, Obsidian's own creator.
skills.desc_en: Interact with Obsidian vaults using the Obsidian CLI to read, create, search, and manage notes, tasks, properties, and more. Also supports plugin and theme development with commands to reload plugins, run JavaScript, capture errors, take screenshots, and inspect the DOM. Use when the user asks to interact with their Obsidian vault, manage notes, search vault content, perform vault operations from
skills.why_zh: 4.6 万星，一手权威：没人比作者更懂这个库的数据模型，比任何第三方封装都可靠。
skills.why_en: Written by Obsidian's CEO — nobody knows the vault data model better; your agent can finally read and write your second brain properly.

skills.name: code-walkthrough
skills.title_zh: 带你读懂一个陌生代码库
skills.tagline_zh: 接手别人的项目，难点从来不是看不懂语法，而是不知道各部分为什么这样连。它从架构到核心流程到关键决策分层讲。
skills.tagline_en: A guide for unfamiliar codebases — architecture, then core flows, then key design decisions, answering why the code is written this way instead of listing files.
skills.desc_en: 代码导读技能：帮助快速理解不熟悉的项目或模块，建立心智模型。 从全局架构到核心流程再到关键设计决策，分层递进地梳理代码。 不是简单地读文件列目录，而是提炼出"这段代码在做什么、为什么这么做、和其他部分怎么连接"。 触发词：帮我梳理一下、这块代码怎么运作的、导读、接手项目、看看这个模块、代码走读、walkthrough。 触发场景：接手新项目、进入不熟悉的模块、重构前理解现状、Code Review 需要理解上下文。 即使用户没有说"导读"，只要意图是"理解一段不熟悉的代码"，都应触发此技能。
skills.why_zh: 目标定得对：它要给你的是心智模型，不是文件清单。
skills.why_en: Building a mental model is the right goal — reading code is hard not because of syntax but because you can't see why parts connect.

skills.name: architecture-diagram
skills.title_zh: 画暗色主题的系统架构图
skills.tagline_zh: 工程汇报要一张说得清的架构图，画起来最耗时。描述清楚系统，它出自包含的 HTML+SVG 暗色架构图，单文件到处能用。
skills.tagline_en: Renders systems, cloud infra and security topologies as polished dark-themed architecture diagrams — self-contained HTML+SVG, one file everywhere.
skills.desc_en: Create polished dark-themed architecture diagrams as self-contained HTML+SVG files. Use when the user asks for system, infrastructure, cloud, security, or network topology diagrams.
skills.why_zh: 6946 星。暗色配色比默认白底图有质感，单文件输出省了导出和依赖的麻烦。
skills.why_en: Dark themes simply look sharper than default white, and single-file output kills export hassle — a showpiece for eng reviews.

skills.name: dev-browser
skills.title_zh: 给 agent 装浏览器
skills.tagline_zh: 给你的 agent 一个能记住状态的真浏览器：导航、填表、截图、抓数据、测网页，会话之间页面状态还在，不用每次从头登录。
skills.tagline_en: Gives your agent a real browser with persistent state — navigate, fill forms, screenshot, scrape and test; pages survive between sessions.
skills.desc_en: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.
skills.why_zh: 「状态持久」是它比一次性无头浏览器强的地方：登录一次后续都在，做需要保持会话的自动化特别顺。
skills.why_en: Persistent state is the edge over throwaway headless browsers — log in once, stay in; smooth for session-bound automation.

skills.name: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm
skills.title_zh: 把公众号视频播客一股脑喂进 NotebookLM
skills.tagline_zh: 想让 NotebookLM 帮你消化一堆资料，光是把内容搬进去就够烦。公众号、网页、YouTube、小宇宙、PDF 丢给它，自动整理上传，还能出播客和思维导图。
skills.tagline_en: WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, podcasts, PDFs — dump them in, auto-processed into NotebookLM as podcasts, slides and mind maps.
skills.desc_en: 多源内容智能处理器：支持微信公众号、网页、YouTube、播客（小宇宙/喜马拉雅）、PDF、Markdown等，自动上传到NotebookLM并生成播客/PPT/思维导图等多种格式。支持深度分析模式和飞书文档自动创建
skills.why_zh: 乔木出品。它吃透了中文内容源（公众号、小宇宙），这块国外工具基本不管。
skills.why_en: By Qiaomu — fully automates feeding multi-source material into NotebookLM, with real fluency in Chinese sources (WeChat, Xiaoyuzhou).

skills.name: swiftui-pro
skills.title_zh: 用 SwiftUI 权威的标准审你的 iOS 代码
skills.tagline_zh: SwiftUI 变化快，AI 常拿过时 API 糊你。作者是 Hacking with Swift 的 Paul Hudson，全球 iOS 开发者的教科书作者——现代 API、可维护性、性能逐项过。
skills.tagline_en: A SwiftUI code-review expert from Paul Hudson — modern APIs, maintainability and performance checked; an authority in your pocket for iOS UI.
skills.desc_en: Comprehensively reviews SwiftUI code for best practices on modern APIs, maintainability, and performance. Use when reading, writing, or reviewing SwiftUI projects.
skills.why_zh: 4469 星。权威性拉满，评审意见是真行家的话，不是训练记忆里的旧写法。
skills.why_en: By Paul Hudson of Hacking with Swift — the iOS world's textbook author; maximal authority, real-expert review.

skills.name: claude-to-im
skills.title_zh: 从手机指挥电脑里跑着的 agent
skills.tagline_zh: 长任务要跑一小时，你却得出门。把会话桥到 Telegram、飞书、微信，手机上发一句就能远程派活，干完还推给你。
skills.tagline_en: Bridges your live agent session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ or WeChat — command the Claude running on your computer straight from your phone.
skills.desc_en: Bridge THIS Claude Code or Codex session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, QQ, or WeChat so the user can chat with Claude from their phone. Use for: setting up, starting, stopping, or diagnosing the claude-to-im bridge daemon; forwarding Claude replies to a messaging app; any phrase like "claude-to-im", "bridge", "消息推送", "消息转发", "桥接", "连上飞书", "手机上看claude", "启动后台服务", "诊断", "查看日志", "配置". Subcommand
skills.why_zh: 歸藏出品，解决的是真痛点：agent 的时间和人的时间从此不用绑在一起。
skills.why_en: By Guizang — solves the real pain of long tasks while you're away; command remotely from your phone, get pinged when done.

skills.name: aso-appstore-screenshots
skills.title_zh: 从代码反推卖点生成 App Store 截图
skills.tagline_zh: 独立开发者最不擅长又最影响下载量的就是商店截图。它先读你的代码库找出核心卖点，再生成 ASO 优化的展示图。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes your app's codebase to surface core benefits, then generates ASO-optimized App Store screenshots — the download page that actually converts.
skills.desc_en: Generate high-converting App Store screenshots by analyzing your app's codebase, discovering core benefits, and creating ASO-optimized screenshot images using Nano Banana Pro.
skills.why_zh: 从代码反推卖点，比对着空白页想文案聪明——素材来自产品本身而不是想象。
skills.why_en: Store screenshots are what indies do worst and download rates need most; deriving benefits from code beats guessing at copy.

skills.name: translate-book
skills.title_zh: 把整本书翻译成任何语言
skills.tagline_zh: 一本书几十万字，串行翻要等到天荒地老。它用并行子 agent 分块同时翻，保留原书排版，输出 HTML/DOCX/EPUB。
skills.tagline_en: Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.
skills.desc_en: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.
skills.why_zh: 并行是关键：把几小时压到几十分钟，而且排版不散——这才让「翻整本书」从设想变成可做的事。
skills.why_en: Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.

skills.name: x-article-publisher
skills.title_zh: 把 Markdown 直接发成 X 长文
skills.tagline_zh: X 的长文编辑器手动排版极其难受，复制过去格式必崩。它把 Markdown 到 X Articles 这一步自动化，写完直接发。
skills.tagline_en: Publishes Markdown articles straight into X's Articles editor with formatting preserved — no manual copy-paste, no broken layout.
skills.desc_en: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.
skills.why_zh: 王树义出品。解决的是发布环节那个没人愿意干的脏活。
skills.why_en: By Wang Shuyi — X's Articles editor is painful to format by hand; this automates Markdown-to-X-Articles so you just publish.

skills.name: math-modeling
skills.title_zh: 三天赛程里做完数学建模竞赛全流程
skills.tagline_zh: 建模竞赛最难的是三天内同时搞定建模、编程、写论文。它按三阶段分工推进，每阶段还有独立质检 subagent 把关。
skills.tagline_en: A full-pipeline assistant for math-modeling contests — modeling, solving in code, visualization and paper writing, with an independent QA subagent per stage.
skills.desc_en: 当用户要求数学建模、建模竞赛、建模分析、代码求解、结果可视化或生成数学建模论文时使用。支持完整三阶段流程、单独执行任一角色，以及在关键节点使用独立 Subagent 进行阶段内质检；默认只启用质检 Subagent，用户可明确选择额外协作。
skills.why_zh: 742 星。按竞赛真实节奏设计的，不是把「数学建模」当学科名词做个通用助手。
skills.why_en: Contest pain is doing modeling, coding and writing in three days; this splits the roles and adds QA gates — designed to the real contest rhythm.

skills.name: GodotPrompter
skills.title_zh: 按 Godot 引擎的范式做游戏
skills.tagline_zh: 通用 agent 不懂节点树和信号，容易用写网页的思路写游戏，跑着就撞墙。这件专修 Godot 4.x 的引擎特有门道。
skills.tagline_en: An agent-skills framework built for Godot 4.x — GDScript, scene trees, nodes and signals all understood; an engine guide for indie games.
skills.desc_en: Agentic skills framework for Godot 4.x. Domain-specific skills for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot, Antigravity, Cursor)
skills.why_zh: 587 星。垂直到具体引擎才有价值——GDScript、场景树、信号这些通用工具一概不管。
skills.why_en: Generic coding agents don't grok Godot's node/signal paradigm and write games with web habits; this specializes in the engine's own patterns.

skills.name: csv-data-summarizer
skills.title_zh: 拿到陌生 CSV 先给它做个体检
skills.tagline_zh: 接手一份没见过的数据，得先知道它长什么样、有没有坑。它用 pandas 出摘要统计、查缺失值、画快速图，几秒钟看清。
skills.tagline_en: Drop in a CSV and get summary stats, missing-value detection and quick plots — pandas under the hood; a health-check for any unfamiliar dataset.
skills.desc_en: Analyzes CSV files, generates summary stats, and plots quick visualizations using Python and pandas.
skills.why_zh: 比自己手写 df.describe() 那套省事，适合每次拿到新数据先跑一遍。
skills.why_en: Run it first on any unfamiliar CSV — seconds to see shape, gaps and quirks; easier than hand-writing the df.describe() dance.

skills.name: email-marketing-bible
skills.title_zh: 做邮件营销的顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 邮件营销细节定成败：发送时机、主题行、自动化触发。5.5 万字、908 个信源、19 个行业剧本，装上它 agent 就是个顾问。
skills.tagline_en: A 55K-word, 908-source, 19-playbook email-marketing skill — install it and your agent becomes an email consultant, from automation to diagnostics.
skills.desc_en: Data-backed email marketing skill for AI agents. Use when building or running email automation, driving an ESP from an agent (MCP/connectors), diagnosing deliverability, writing or de-slopping email copy, designing emails, choosing a platform, or pulling benchmarks. Covers AI email automation, flows, deliverability, copywriting, segmentation, compliance, cold email, WhatsApp, SMS and RCS, and 19 i
skills.why_zh: 内容密度惊人且有信源，不是泛泛而谈——这种「细节定成败」的领域，厚知识库就是硬实力。
skills.why_en: Staggering density (55K words, 908 sources), not hand-waving; in email marketing where details decide outcomes, a thick knowledge base is real muscle.

skills.name: dnd
skills.title_zh: 一个人也能玩的 D&D 地下城主

skills.name: positioning-and-story

skills.name: university-exam-prep
